review: Remember Cinq East Don? Now here comes the marginally cooler Cinq East Don. Like Cinq East Don, Cinq East Hong Lu’s kit revolves around stacking “Nerve Strike” by focusing on one target at a time while using Burn and Poise as a complement. Starting with his 2 unique statuses: - Witnessed - Eastern Cinq - Buff that grants Offense Level based on the stacks, giving an extra Poise Potency on 2+ stacks and Poise Count at 3+ stacks. - Nerve Strike - Hong Lu - Debuff that gives Hong Lu either clash power, base power, or both, in that order based on the number of stacks when hitting the target with this debuff. Do remember that this debuff will conflict with other Cinq East IDs (currently only Cinq East Don).
